content.text: Many digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya face restrictions from PayPal, Stripe, and Gumroad, limiting their ability to sell products online. This creates a critical need for an infrastructure that allows seamless transactions without relying on traditional platforms. This post explores the core components necessary for implementing a reliable payment system that bypasses conventional restrictions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today: Crypto payment

To begin deploying your crypto payment infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting solution such as GitHub Pages for free hosting. Next, set up your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders. Create a product catalog and store order information using Supabase or Google Sheets. After that, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept a wide array of digital currencies. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your setup.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to just 0.5%, maximizing your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider utilizing a crypto payment gateway. By implementing solutions like NOWPayments, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring your sales are secure and efficient. This method allows you to avoid high fees and platform restrictions while maintaining full control over your digital products.
Automated delivery ensures your customers receive their purchases instantly, boosting satisfaction.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees or the limitations of services like Gumroad, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the blueprints and templates needed to build a sovereign digital commerce stack, enabling you to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products directly to your audience.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your digital products and create a catalog. Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages for your storefront. Set up your backend with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order management. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store and retrieve order data. Configure NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments securely. Test your entire setup to ensure smooth operation before launching.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins. This wide selection allows you to cater to a diverse customer base while minimizing transaction fees.
How do I deliver digital products automatically?

You can automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools allow you to set up scripts that deliver purchased items immediately upon confirmed payment, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
Do I need technical skills to set this up?

While some technical skills are beneficial, the architecture is designed to be user-friendly. By following the provided documentation and leveraging tools like Google Sheets, you can set up your digital storefront with minimal coding knowledge.
What are the ongoing costs associated with using this infrastructure?

The primary cost is the 0.5% fee charged by NOWPayments for processing transactions. Unlike traditional platforms, there are no subscription fees or hidden charges, allowing you to retain more of your revenue.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?

Absolutely. This infrastructure is built to scale. You can easily add more products, increase your order processing capacity, and expand your offerings without being constrained by platform limitations.
You own your entire payment infrastructure, eliminating dependency on third-party platforms.
